meta.title: Drillr - football fitness training for your position
meta.description: Football fitness built for the position you actually play. Home or gym, one plan shaped around your role, your level, and the time you've got.

hero.subtitle: Drillr is the football fitness app built around the position you actually play. Home or gym, shaped to your role, your level, and the time you've got.

usedBy.title: 2200+ players train with us
usedBy.subtitle: From U14s to semi-pro, in 80+ countries, every single day.

steps.title: Pick your position
steps.body: Striker, winger, keeper, whatever you play, we shape the plan around what your role actually asks of you.

steps.title: Train every day
steps.body: Short, honest sessions. 25-45 minutes is enough to change how you play, and Drillr keeps count for you.

steps.title: Watch yourself grow
steps.body: Streaks, stats, little milestones. Once you start stringing days together, it gets hard to stop.

items.title: Workouts built for your position
items.body: Goalkeeper, defender, midfielder, forward. Every exercise is picked for what your position actually demands.

items.title: A calendar that fits your week
items.body: Your training days, gym access, and experience level all go into the plan. It bends around your life, not the other way round.

items.title: Video demos for everything
items.body: Clear instructions, sets, reps, and a short video for every move. You'll never guess what something should look like.

items.title: Stretching that matches your game
items.body: Mobility work aimed at the muscles you actually use on the pitch, not a generic cooldown.

items.name: Alex M.
items.quote: Honestly didn't expect much, but after a month my coach said I was positioning way better. Stamina is crazy now too.

items.name: Sara K.
items.quote: My friend showed me the app and now I'm on it every day. The workouts actually make sense for my position.

items.name: Daniel R.
items.quote: The position-specific stuff is what hooked me. Every session feels like it's for my game.

items.name: Jakub W.
items.quote: Goalkeeper-specific work is rare in apps. Drillr nails it. My reactions and footwork are both up.

items.name: Maya L.
items.quote: I love the calendar - it adapts when I miss a day instead of guilt-tripping me.

items.name: Tomasz B.
items.quote: 30 minutes a day, 4 days a week, and I feel like a different player on Sundays.

positionPicker.title: What position do you play?
positionPicker.subtitle: Tap a position to see what Drillr does for it.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Drillr

Most sessions run 25-45 minutes. You can train 3, 5, or 6 days a week depending on the goal you pick during onboarding.
Yes. You can go through onboarding and try a sample of your plan for free. The full weekly plan and the rest of the exercises are behind a subscription.
Drillr is built for ages 13 and up. Younger players should train under the eye of a coach or parent.

items.q: I'm just starting out - is this too advanced?
items.a: Drillr meets you where you are. You set your level during onboarding, and the plan scales volume and difficulty around it. A first-time trainer gets a different week than someone already playing club football five days a week.

items.q: What if I play multiple positions?
items.a: Pick the one you play most often. You can switch positions any time in settings and your plan will rebuild around the new one.

items.q: Can I use Drillr alongside my coach's program?
items.a: Yes, loads of players do. Drillr is meant to sit next to team training, not replace it. Dial down your weekly volume if you start feeling cooked.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a: Cancel any time from your device's subscription settings, or through our Manage Subscription page if you signed up on the web.

coachesCta.title: Coaching a team or running an academy?
coachesCta.body: We're working on team plans, group dashboards, and academy partnerships. Drop us a line and we'll be in touch.

finalCta.title: Start training for your position
finalCta.body: Pick your position, try a sample of your plan for free, and see how a week built around your role actually feels.
finalCta.note: Free to try. iOS and Android.

positions.indexSubtitle: Every Drillr plan is shaped around what your position actually demands.

goalkeeper.name: Goalkeeper
goalkeeper.description: Reflexes and positioning are what make great keepers. Drillr sharpens both with reaction work, lateral movement, and core stability - the stuff most apps skip.
goalkeeper.strengths: Drillr builds the explosive lateral mobility, reaction speed, and core stability that separate good keepers from great ones.
goalkeeper.weaknesses: Most keepers quietly skip lateral mobility and lower-body power. We won't let you.

defender.name: Defender
defender.description: Aerial wins, clean tackles, quick recovery runs - it all starts in the gym. Drillr builds the strength and stamina that carry 1v1s and clear lines.
defender.strengths: Aerial wins and tackling power start in the gym. Drillr trains both, plus the agility most defenders quietly skip.
defender.weaknesses: Defenders often skip agility - quick feet save goals too. We keep yours sharp.

midfielder.name: Midfielder
midfielder.description: Box-to-box asks for the full toolkit. Drillr builds the engine, the agility, and the mobility you need to run the middle from the first whistle to the last.
midfielder.strengths: Box-to-box asks for the full toolkit. Drillr gets you ready for the whole 90.
midfielder.weaknesses: Central midfielders who skip mobility pick up more late-game injuries. Drillr won't let that slide.

forward.name: Forward
forward.description: Explosive acceleration and sharp changes of direction are your edge. Drillr trains the pace, the power, and the agility that get you in behind, plus the strength to hold defenders off when you do.
forward.strengths: Explosive acceleration and sharp changes of direction are your edge. Drillr trains them every single week.
forward.weaknesses: Forwards who skip strength lose the touchline duels. We make sure you don't.

faq.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.a: Subscriptions are billed by the App Store or Google Play, so you cancel from your device's store settings. The manage subscription page has direct links for each store.
Refunds are handled by Apple and Google, not by us. Request one through the App Store or Google Play, and email us if you need a hand.

faq.q: How do I delete my account or data?
faq.a: Open Settings > Delete Account in the app - that removes your profile and all your training data straight away. If you can't get into your account, email us from the address it's tied to and we'll do it for you. What we store is listed in our privacy policy.

faq.q: I found a bug. What should I do?
faq.a: Send us the details through the feedback form or by email - screenshots and your device model help us fix it faster.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: This page explains how to delete your Drillr account and what happens to your data when you do. Drillr is developed by Tomasz Święcki. You can delete your account yourself from inside the app in a few seconds, or ask us to do it for you by email.

sections.heading: Delete your account from inside the app
paragraphs: This is the fastest way and it takes effect immediately. You do not need to contact us.
bullets: Open Drillr and go to the Settings tab
Scroll to the Account section
Tap Delete Account, the last row in that section
Confirm when asked - this cannot be undone

sections.heading: Delete your account by email
paragraphs: If you cannot sign in, or you would rather we did it for you, email drillrapps@gmail.com from the address your account is registered to, with the subject "Account Deletion Request". We need the message to come from the registered address so we can confirm the account is yours.
We action these within 30 days, and normally within a few working days. We will confirm by email once it is done.

sections.heading: What is deleted
paragraphs: Deleting your account permanently removes the following. None of it can be recovered afterwards, by you or by us.
bullets: Your profile - name, email address, position, height, weight, birthday and gender
Your full training history - every completed exercise, session and date
Your recorded weights and weight history
Your effort and readiness entries, and your match evaluations
Your username, which is released so it can be used again
Your sign-in credentials, so the account can no longer be logged into
All Drillr data stored locally on your device

sections.heading: What is kept, and for how long
paragraphs: A small amount of information survives account deletion, for the reasons given below. None of it can be used to sign in, and none of it identifies you inside the app.
If you want the analytics records erased as well, say so in your email and we will remove them. Ask us directly rather than assuming deletion covers it.
bullets: Purchase and subscription records held by Apple, Google and our billing provider RevenueCat. These are transaction records we are required to retain for tax and accounting purposes, and we cannot delete them on your behalf
Pseudonymous product analytics - which screens were opened and which features were used, tied to a random identifier rather than to your name or email
Crash and error reports, which contain diagnostic information about the app rather than information about you
A record that you asked not to be contacted again, if you have ever told us that. We keep only what is needed to honour that request

sections.heading: Deleting your account does not cancel your subscription
paragraphs: Subscriptions are billed by Apple and Google, not by us, so deleting your Drillr account does not stop the billing. Cancel through your Apple ID or Google Play account settings before you delete, or you will continue to be charged.
Our Manage Subscription page has direct links for both stores. If you have already deleted your account and are still being billed, email drillrapps@gmail.com and we will help you sort it out.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy is applicable to the Drillr app (hereinafter referred to as "Application") for mobile devices, which was developed by Tomasz Święcki (hereinafter referred to as "Service Provider") as a Freemium service, and to the Drillr website at getdrillr.app (hereinafter referred to as "Website"). This service is provided "AS IS".

sections.heading: What information does the Application obtain and how is it used?
paragraphs: The Application acquires the information you supply when you download and register the Application. Registration with the Service Provider is not mandatory. However, bear in mind that you might not be able to utilize some of the features offered by the Application unless you register with them.

The Service Provider may also use the information you provided to contact you from time to time to provide you with important information, required notices and marketing promotions. The Application also sends local reminders and notifications from your device, such as training-day and match reminders, which you can turn off at any time in your device settings.

The Service Provider uses this information to create and adapt your personalized training and nutrition plans, operate your account, and improve the Application. Some of this information - in particular body metrics and injury status - is treated as special-category (health-related) data under data-protection law. The Service Provider processes it only on the basis of your explicit consent, which you give by choosing to enter this optional information so that the Application can personalize your plans. You can withdraw your consent at any time by removing the data in Settings or deleting your account, without affecting the rest of the Application. When you create an account and use the Application, the Service Provider may collect the following categories of personal data:
bullets: Account data: your email address, the display name and optional username you choose, and, for email sign-in, a password that is stored only in hashed form by the authentication provider.
Sign-in data: if you sign in with Apple or Google, the name and email address (including an Apple private-relay email, if you use one) that the provider shares with the Application.
Profile and body data you enter: your age or date of birth, gender, height, weight and weight history, nationality, and playing position.
Training and lifestyle preferences: your goals, focus areas, experience level, available equipment and gym access, training days and session length, team status, and dietary preferences.
Health-related information you choose to provide, such as your current injury status and how nervous or confident you feel before matches. This is optional and the Application works without it.
Activity and performance data generated as you use the Application, such as completed sessions and drills, effort and feedback ratings, and match self-evaluations.
Subscription and purchase data, as described in the next section.

sections.heading: What information does the Application collect automatically?
paragraphs: In addition, the Application may collect certain information automatically, including, but not limited to, the type of mobile device you use, your mobile device's unique device ID, the IP address of your mobile device, your mobile operating system, the type of mobile Internet browsers you use, and information about the way you use the Application.

We use PostHog to understand how users interact with the Application, including screens visited, features used, and actions taken. This analytics collection is enabled by default and forms part of the service you accept when you create an account, sign in, or otherwise use the Application. The Service Provider relies on its legitimate interest in securing, maintaining, and improving the Application as the legal basis for this processing. You can object at any time by contacting drillrapps@gmail.com, you can stop all collection by uninstalling the Application, and you can limit advertising and analytics identifiers through your device's privacy settings.

When you purchase a subscription, the Application also receives your transaction ID, subscription status, purchase date, renewal date, and the product you purchased. Payment itself (credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay) is handled entirely by Apple or Google - the Service Provider never sees or stores your payment card details.

sections.heading: What information does the Website collect?
paragraphs: This Policy also covers the Drillr website at getdrillr.app. The Website is an information and support site: you can read every page without an account, and it sets no advertising, profiling, or cross-site tracking cookies.

The Website is hosted by Vercel, which keeps standard server access logs - including your IP address, the page requested, and your browser type - for security, abuse prevention, and reliability. The Service Provider also uses Vercel Web Analytics to see how many people visit each page and where they arrive from. Vercel Web Analytics is cookieless: it stores nothing on your device and builds no persistent profile of you, and the Service Provider sees only aggregate figures such as page views, referrer, country, and device type. The legal basis for both is the Service Provider's legitimate interest in operating, securing, and improving the Website.

The feedback form at getdrillr.app/feedback is provided by Tally and embedded from their servers. The "Send feedback" link inside the Application opens the same form. What you submit through it - the category you choose, the details you write, an optional screenshot or video you attach, and an email address if you choose to give one so that the Service Provider can reply - is sent to Tally and passed on to the Service Provider, and is used only to reply to you and to act on what you report. Tally stores form responses on servers in the European Union. Please do not attach a screenshot or video showing other people. The embedded form may set cookies that are strictly necessary for it to work; it does not set advertising or tracking cookies. If you would rather not use the form at all, you can email drillrapps@gmail.com instead.

Fonts are served from the Website's own domain, so reading a page does not send a request to any third-party font or advertising network. The App Store and Google Play buttons take you to Apple's and Google's own sites, which are governed by their privacy policies rather than this one.

sections.heading: Does the Application collect location information of the device?
paragraphs: This Application does not gather information about the location of your mobile device.

sections.heading: Does the Application use Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies?
paragraphs: The Application includes an optional form-analysis feature that uses on-device motion and body-pose detection built into your phone (such as Apple's Vision framework on iOS) to give you feedback on your exercise technique. All of this analysis runs entirely on your device. No video, image, or body-pose data is sent to the Service Provider or any third party for this feature, and it is not used to identify you. See the section on camera use below for details.

sections.heading: Does the Application use your camera, and what happens to recordings?
paragraphs: The Application includes an optional form-check feature that uses your device's camera. The camera is accessed only when you choose to start a form check for a supported exercise, and only to record a short clip of you performing that exercise. You can decline or revoke the camera permission at any time in your device settings; the rest of the Application continues to work without it.

The recorded clip is analyzed entirely on your device. The Service Provider does not receive, upload, or store your clip on any server, the clip is not saved to your photo library automatically, and it is not shared with any third party. The Application does not record audio as part of this feature.

If you choose to share a clip using the share option, the Application creates a version with a Drillr watermark and the on-screen form feedback drawn into it, and hands it to your device's standard share sheet. From the moment you select a destination (for example a messaging app, social network, or contact), the clip is governed by that service's or recipient's own terms and privacy policy, not by this Policy, and the Service Provider has no control over how they handle it. Please only share clips of yourself, and do not share clips showing other people without their consent.

sections.heading: Does the Application use automated decision-making or profiling?
paragraphs: The Application uses the information you provide - such as your goals, experience level, body metrics, and injury status - to automatically generate and adapt your personalized training and nutrition plans. This includes selecting drills, adjusting the difficulty of workouts, and calculating calorie and macronutrient targets. This amounts to profiling, but it is the core purpose of the Application that you sign up for, and it does not produce legal or similarly significant effects for you.

The Application does not make solely automated decisions that produce legal effects concerning you. You remain in control: you can change the inputs at any time in Settings, and you can contact the Service Provider at drillrapps@gmail.com with any questions about how your plan is generated.

sections.heading: Do third parties see and/or have access to information obtained by the Application?
paragraphs: The Service Provider transmits pseudonymous identifiers (such as a user ID and device identifier) to the external services listed below to authenticate your account, sync your subscription status, collect diagnostic data, and improve the Application. The Service Provider may share your information with third parties in the ways that are described in this privacy statement.

Your account and profile data are stored using Google Firebase (Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore), and sign-in with Apple or Google is handled by the respective provider. These providers act as the Service Provider's processors and may store data on servers located outside your country, including in the United States, under appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.

Please note that the Application utilizes third-party services that have their own Privacy Policy about handling data. Below are the links to the Privacy Policy of the third-party service providers used by the Application:
bullets: https://policies.google.com/privacy
https://firebase.google.com/policies/analytics
https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy
https://expo.dev/privacy
https://posthog.com/privacy - product analytics, hosted in the European Union
https://sentry.io/privacy/ - crash and error reporting
https://www.revenuecat.com/privacy - subscription management and billing analytics
https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy - hosting and cookieless analytics for the Website
https://tally.so/help/privacy-policy - the feedback form on the Website
https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/ - for iOS purchases
https://policies.google.com/privacy - for Android purchases

sections.heading: When may the Service Provider disclose your information?
paragraphs: The Service Provider may disclose User Provided and Automatically Collected Information:
bullets: as required by law, such as to comply with a subpoena, or similar legal process;
when they believe in good faith that disclosure is necessary to protect their rights, protect your safety or the safety of others, investigate fraud, or respond to a government request;

with their trusted services providers who work on their behalf, do not have an independent use of the information disclosed to them, and have agreed to adhere to the rules set forth in this privacy statement.

sections.heading: What are my opt-out rights?
paragraphs: You can halt all collection of information by the Application easily by uninstalling the Application. You may use the standard uninstall processes as may be available as part of your mobile device or via the mobile application marketplace or network. Uninstalling the Application does not automatically cancel a paid subscription - you must cancel through your Apple ID or Google Play account settings.
You can also permanently delete your account and all associated data directly in the Application at any time, under Settings > Delete Account.

sections.heading: What is the data retention policy and how can you manage your information?
paragraphs: The Service Provider will retain User Provided data for as long as you use the Application and for a reasonable time thereafter. The Service Provider will retain Automatically Collected information for up to 24 months and thereafter may store it in aggregate. If you'd like the Service Provider to delete User Provided Data that you have provided via the Application, please contact them at drillrapps@gmail.com and they will respond in a reasonable time. Please note that some or all of the User Provided Data may be required in order for the Application to function properly.

You can also delete your account and all associated data yourself at any time within the Application, under Settings > Delete Account, which immediately removes your profile along with your training, weight, effort, and match data from the Service Provider's systems.

Feedback sent through the form described above is kept only for as long as it takes to deal with it. Once your report has been answered or resolved, the Service Provider deletes the response from Tally, including any screenshot or video you attached and any email address you gave.

sections.heading: Your data protection rights
paragraphs: The data controller responsible for your personal data is Tomasz Święcki, an independent developer based in Poland, who can be contacted at drillrapps@gmail.com. Given the nature and scale of the processing, the Service Provider is not required to appoint a Data Protection Officer and has not done so; you can send any privacy questions to the same address.

The Service Provider processes your personal data on the following legal bases: to perform the agreement to provide the Application to you; your consent - including your explicit consent for special-category health-related data such as body metrics and injuries, and your consent for marketing messages; and the Service Provider's legitimate interest in operating, securing, and improving the Application.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or a region with comparable laws, you have the rights listed below regarding your personal data. To exercise any of them, contact the Service Provider at drillrapps@gmail.com; you can also edit your profile in the Application or permanently delete your account and data under Settings > Delete Account.
bullets: the right to access the personal data held about you;
the right to have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected;
the right to have your data erased (the "right to be forgotten");
the right to restrict or object to certain processing;
the right to data portability, that is, to receive your data in a structured, commonly used format;
the right to withdraw consent at any time, where processing is based on consent;
the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority - in Poland, the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (Prezes Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych).

sections.heading: Your rights if you live in the United States
paragraphs: If you are a resident of California, or of another US state with a comprehensive privacy law such as Colorado, Connecticut, Montana, Oregon, Texas, or Virginia, you have the additional rights set out below. The categories of personal data the Service Provider collects, the purposes they are used for, and how long they are kept are described earlier in this Policy.

The Service Provider does not sell your personal information and does not share it for cross-context behavioural advertising, and has not done so in the preceding twelve months. There is no advertising network, data broker, or ad-targeting technology in the Application or on the Website. The Service Provider also does not knowingly sell or share the personal information of anyone under 16.

The Application collects some information that California law treats as sensitive personal information, namely health-related data such as your body metrics and injury status. The Service Provider uses it only to generate and adapt the training and nutrition plans you signed up for, and not to infer characteristics about you, so the right to limit the use of sensitive personal information does not restrict any processing that actually takes place.

To exercise any of the rights below, email drillrapps@gmail.com from the address linked to your account, or delete your account and its data yourself at any time under Settings > Delete Account in the Application. You may use an authorised agent, in which case the Service Provider may ask for proof of their authority and for confirmation from you directly. The Service Provider will respond within the period your state's law allows, and if a request is declined you can appeal by replying to the same address. Subject to the law of your state, you have the right to:
bullets: know what personal information is collected about you, and to obtain a copy of it;
have inaccurate personal information corrected;
have your personal information deleted;
receive your data in a portable, machine-readable form;

opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information, of targeted advertising, and of profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects - none of which the Service Provider carries out;

not be discriminated against for exercising any of these rights. The Service Provider does not offer financial incentives in exchange for personal data, and the Application works the same way whether or not you exercise them.

sections.heading: How does the Application address children's privacy?
paragraphs: The Application is intended for users aged 13 and older. The Service Provider does not knowingly solicit data from or market to children under the age of 13.

In some countries the minimum age for consenting to the processing of personal data is higher than 13 - for example, 16 in Poland and parts of the European Union. The Application is available to users aged 13 and older everywhere. If you are at least 13 but below the digital-consent age in your country, you may use the Application and provide your personal data only with the involvement and consent of a parent or legal guardian, who accepts this Policy on your behalf.

Users who indicate during onboarding that they are under the age of 13 cannot create an account. The Application displays a message that Drillr is for ages 13 and up, and no profile is created on the Service Provider's systems.

A small number of accounts created before this age gate took effect remain on the Service in a legacy Restricted Mode. In Restricted Mode, the Application does not collect personal details such as gender, height, weight, or date of birth. Only an email address is retained for account authentication purposes. No personal data from Restricted Mode users is shared with third parties or used for profiling or marketing.

If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal information, please contact the Service Provider (drillrapps@gmail.com) so that they will be able to take the necessary actions, including account deletion.

sections.heading: How is your information kept secure?
paragraphs: The Service Provider is concerned about safeguarding the confidentiality of your information. The Service Provider provides physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards to protect information they process and maintain. For example, access to this information is limited to authorized employees and contractors who need to know it in order to operate, develop, or improve the Application. Please be aware that, although the Service Provider endeavors to provide reasonable security for information they process and maintain, no security system can prevent all potential security breaches.

sections.heading: How will you be informed of changes to this Privacy Policy?
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time for any reason. The Service Provider will notify you of any changes to the Privacy Policy by updating this page with the new Privacy Policy. You are advised to consult this Privacy Policy regularly for any changes, as continued use is deemed approval of all changes.

sections.heading: How do you give your consent?
paragraphs: By creating an account, signing in, or otherwise using the Application, you acknowledge this Privacy Policy and agree to the Service Provider processing your information as set forth here now and as amended in the future, including the analytics used to operate, secure, and improve the Application. "Processing" means using or handling information in any way, including, but not limited to, collecting, storing, deleting, using, combining and disclosing information.

sections.heading: How can you contact us?
paragraphs: If you have any questions regarding privacy while using the Application, or have questions about the practices, please contact the Service Provider via email at drillrapps@gmail.com.

paragraphs: The Application includes an optional form-check feature that records a short clip and gives you automated feedback on your exercise technique.
